title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer Terms: Share of the Calibration Quote Collected at Acceptance
content:
The share of the calibration quote collected at acceptance of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay calibration is the **whole quote (1)** where the customer's most recent estimate booking that ended as a no-show closed no more than 183 days before the record date, **three quarters (0.75)** where it closed more than 183 but no more than 730 days before, and **half (0.5)** otherwise.

## Records the share is read from

The customer's Repair Estimates & Appointments bookings: the most recent booking that ended with the status no-show, and the date it closed. Days are calendar days counted from that closed date to the record date the no-show is measured to, the closed date not counted. Where the customer has no estimate booking that ended as a no-show, the days are taken as 99999 and the share is half.

## Share by no-show history

| Most recent no-show booking closed, days before the record date | Share of the calibration quote collected |
|---|---|
| no more than 183 | the whole quote (1) |
| more than 183, no more than 730 | three quarters (0.75) |
| more than 730, or no no-show booking | half (0.5) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Closed 183 days before the record date: the whole quote; 184 days before: three quarters.
- Closed 730 days before: three quarters; 731 days before: half.

## Illustration (hypothetical calibration quote of 349.00 USD)

The share collected is 349.00 USD at the whole quote, 261.75 USD at three quarters and 174.50 USD at half.
